Source: https://github.com/MengTo/Skills — MIT License, © Meng To.
Retrieved 2026-07-27 (announced via x.com/MengTo/status/2080915786206789733).

These SKILL.md files cover three.js action combat, enemy systems/AI tuning,
game VFX, audio feedback, optimization, playable-web testing, hybrid assets,
camera controls, shipping, and isometric ARPG structure. They are REFERENCE
material for the build pipeline's prompt corpus — adapt, don't copy blindly:
where they conflict with GAME_DOCTRINE.md (which is grounded in our own
measured failures), the doctrine wins.
